fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: The operator's name for this provider tenant, e.g. 'Acefone TatvaPractice'.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The provider that places and receives this account's calls; an account whose provider has no registered adapter is never routed to.
Ticked, this account can place and receive calls, and its webhook token authenticates. Left off, it is inert — the switch is per account, not per provider.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The line the provider rings first on a click-to-call, before it dials the patient. Optional: a CRM Telephony Agent Map row overrides it per agent. Any format — the number is reduced to its last 10 digits before use.
fields.label: Agent Callback Number

fields.description: The number shown to the patient on an outbound call. Inbound calls are NOT matched on this — a DID is mapped to its grain in CRM Telephony Routing. Any format — reduced to its last 10 digits before use.
fields.label: Caller ID (outbound)
Provider Credentials (outbound — the CRM calls the provider)

fields.description: The provider's API base URL, without a trailing slash. Blank uses the code default (Acefone: https://api.acefone.in).
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The provider's API bearer token for this tenant, taken from the vault; every outbound call is authenticated with it.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: Only for Acefone's separate 'Support' click-to-call variant. Left blank otherwise.
fields.label: Click-to-Call API Key
Webhook Token
fields.description: Created by the 'Generate Webhook Token' button above: click it, save, then use 'Copy Webhook URLs' and register them with the provider. It proves the caller is the provider and tells the CRM which account the call arrived on. Blank means inbound is off.

fields.label: Recording Host Allowlist (SSRF)
fields.description: The provider's webhook carries a URL, and the CRM downloads the call recording from it. Listing the provider's recording hosts here means the CRM downloads from those hosts only, so a forged webhook cannot point the server at a URL of the attacker's choosing. Blank allows any public host (private and internal addresses are always blocked).

fields.label: Inbound Webhook (the provider calls the CRM)

fields.description: Set during a rotation; both tokens authenticate until this one is cleared. Acefone retries a rejected delivery only twice, so a call rejected mid-rotation is lost for good.
fields.label: Previous Webhook Token

fields.description: Derived, never entered. A Password field cannot be indexed, so this digest is what makes authentication one read rather than a scan and decrypt of every account.
fields.label: Token Digest

fields.description: The token is always enforced. HMAC is added only for a provider that signs its payloads, which Acefone does not.
fields.label: Authentication
HMAC Signing Secret
fields.description: The shared secret the provider signs its payloads with.
The header carrying the provider's signature, e.g. X-Signature.
fields.label: Signature Header
Signature Algorithm
fields.description: The hash the provider signs with.

fields.label: Signature Encoding
fields.description: How the provider encodes the signature it sends.
Stripped before comparison, e.g. 'sha256='. Left blank when the provider sends a bare signature.
fields.label: Signature Prefix

fields.description: Rejects any inbound call that does not come from an address listed below. Leave it off unless the provider publishes fixed addresses — a wrong list silently drops every call. It cannot be turned on while the list is empty.
fields.label: Enforce IP Allowlist

fields.description: One IP address or CIDR range per line, e.g. 13.234.10.5 or 13.234.0.0/16. Anything after a # is ignored. Read only when Enforce IP Allowlist is ticked.
fields.label: Allowed Addresses
